status: Consolidated data drop of the geometric LOD study: the R3 main matrix and the R4 heat-transfer sub-study of drop 1 (D-193) with the R5 serial timing costs (D-200, D-202) and the R6 study report and methodology (D-203). Every stage of the run plan is complete; nothing is pending. The recommendations are drop 1's, unchanged; the main file adds a cost object to the 12 timed references and 206 timed test sites and a timing block (schema 1.1.0), and the sub-study file carries the zoning of its 24 failed sites (D-201, D-203).

study.name: lod-study-v1
study.title: How Much Thermal Zoning Detail Is Enough?
study.design: Each test case is one DOE/PNNL prototype building generated by BEMGen's DOE generator at the prototype's own dimensions, with the prototype's atlas programs (deterministic ruleset schedules), the atlas 90.1 unified construction set of its vintage and climate zone, and the pinned TMY3 weather of the zone's representative city. The reference site is the prototype's full zoning (NoSimplification + Stack, IWHT and FHT on); the test sites are the zoning simplifications with geometry, programs, envelope and weather fixed. Ideal-loads sensible heating and cooling are the primary outputs; HVAC and service hot water are excluded.

lod-recommendations.json.label: R3 main matrix with the R5 serial costs
lod-recommendations.json.content: 11 prototypes x 6 climate zones (2A, 2B, 3C, 4A, 5A, 7A) x 2 vintages (90.1-2007, 90.1-2019) x 2 orientations (0, 45 degrees), 264 test cases, the 24 main zonings (IWHT and FHT on) each; a cost object on the 12 timed references and 206 timed test sites of R5 (90.1-2019, 3C and 5A, 0 degrees; no medium office or primary school) and a top-level timing block
lod-recommendations.json.transformation: copied byte for byte from BEMGen's committed results file (written compact, LF line endings; source_sha256 is BEMGen's file, sha256 the repository file, equal here)

lod-recommendations-ht.json.label: R4 heat-transfer sub-study
lod-recommendations-ht.json.content: 11 prototypes x 2 climate zones (3C, 5A) x 90.1-2019 x 0 degrees, 22 test cases, the 24 main zonings x interior-wall heat transfer (IWHT) on and off x floor heat transfer (FHT) on and off, 96 zonings each; the 24 failed small-hotel sites carry their zoning from the suite (D-203), otherwise drop 1's content
lod-recommendations-ht.json.transformation: copied byte for byte from BEMGen's committed results file except CRLF line endings normalised to LF (source_sha256 is BEMGen's file, sha256 the repository file)
